title: Alpha++ full algorithm

steps_implemented: build_footprint: classifies every ordered activity pair as Causal (→), Parallel (∥, L2L), or Choice (#)
L1L detection: self-loop activities (a,a) in directly-follows set
find_maximal_pairs: greedy merge of seed (a→b) pairs into maximal (A,B) candidate places via is_valid_pair
Petri net construction: source/sink places, one transition per activity, one place per (A,B) pair, L1L self-loop places
L2L back-arcs implicit via Parallel footprint classification
